name: SignThis
summary: E-signature tool with a free plan, where the sender can require a palm scan from signers before a signature counts.
best_for: senders who sign a few documents a month for free, or who want to require a palm scan from signers before a signature counts
skip_if: you need notarization, identity-document checks, contract lifecycle management or a catalog of integrations, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The standout feature, sender-required palm verification, needs a paid plan, the Very app on every signer's phone, and extra envelopes per signer, and we have not tested it. The product leaves out notarization, identity-document checks, contract lifecycle management and ready-made integrations.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · Free plan 3 documents a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-14 on signthis.pro and signthis.pro/reviewers, US dollars a month before tax) SignThis has a free plan that sends 3 documents a month with no card and no end date; the allowance renews on the first day of each month (UTC) and is shared by every workspace one person creates. Individual plans have no annual commitment: Basic is $8 a month for 6 envelopes a month (the first month is $5 for a new subscriber), Standard is $20 a month for 120 envelopes a year and 25 saved templates, Professional is $25 a month for 200 envelopes a year and 100 templates with the REST API, signed webhooks and an MCP server, and Secure is $49 a month for 400 envelopes a year. Business plans need a 12-month commitment billed monthly: Starter is $30 a seat with 100 envelopes a year per seat and single sign-on, Standard is $35 a seat (3-seat minimum) with unlimited envelopes under fair use, and Professional is $65 a seat (3-seat minimum) with 500 templates. An ordinary send uses one envelope per document whatever the number of signers. VerySecure palm verification uses 2 envelopes per signer, or 1 per signer on Secure, and is not part of the free sending allowance. We have not paid for a plan, so tax is not known.

compare_with.name: DocuSign
compare_with.why: DocuSign is the big incumbent with a long integration list, while SignThis is smaller, cheaper at the low end and adds sender-required palm verification. Compare the envelope limits per year against your sending volume
